channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Ubuntu still has not released patch for Linux 0day RCE in almost 3 weeks
item.description: No patched kernels are available yet for 22.04, 24.04, or 26.04 despite a CVSS 9.8 rating. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: New Release: Tor Browser 16.0
item.description: Tor Browser 16.0 is now available, featuring an update to Firefox ESR 153, a redesigned Settings experience for desktop, and a modern user interface powered by Jetpack Compose for Android. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Amazon Aurora MySQL 3.14 (compatible with MySQL 8.0.46) is generally available
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Aurora MySQL-Compatible Edition 3 (compatible with MySQL 8.0) supports MySQL 8.0.46, which includes community MySQL fixes and Aurora-specific improvements. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Aurora MySQL 8.4.10 is now generally available
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Aurora MySQL-Compatible Edition 8.4 supports MySQL 8.4.10. We recommend upgrading to the newer minor versions to accept fixes for Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) in prior versions of MySQL and to benefit… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon RDS now supports per snapshot billing
item.description: Starting today, Amazon RDS supports per snapshot billing for Amazon RDS snapshots. Per snapshot billing allows you to get the cost of each individual snapshot. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Haiku 5.5 now available on Kiro in AWS GovCloud (US)
item.description: A new Anthropic model is now available in the Kiro IDE and CLI for the AWS GovCloud (US) Regions. With Haiku 5.5, all three Claude 5.5 models are now available in Kiro in AWS GovCloud (US). (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Quick on desktop now uses your organization's existing Amazon Quick sign-in
item.description: For organizations that use Amazon Quick, the desktop application now signs users in with the same sign-in method the organization already uses for Quick on the web. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Lambda now supports queues for Apache Kafka in self-managed Kafka event sources
item.description: AWS Lambda now supports queues for Apache Kafka in self-managed Kafka event source mappings (ESM), for Kafka clusters that customers run themselves and for managed offerings such as Confluent Cloud. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Java News Roundup: TornadoVM 8.0, JNoSQL, Endive, JReleaser, JBang, LangChain4j, Quarkus Almanac
item.description: This week's Java roundup for October 26th, 2026, features news highlighting: the GA release of TornadoVM 8.0; point releases of JNoSQL, Endive, JBang, JReleaser and LangChain4j; a maintenance release of JobRunr; beta releases of Hibernate… (1 source: infoq)
